classes.name: stack
classes.description: vertical flex column, children separated by gap (--gap, default m)

classes.name: row
classes.description: horizontal flex row, wraps, children vertically centred (--gap)

classes.name: grid
classes.description: responsive columns, as many as fit; --min sets minimum column width (default 16rem)

classes.name: container
classes.description: centred content column, max 72rem, side padding

classes.name: sidebar
classes.description: first child is a fixed sidebar (--side, default 16rem), second child fills; stacks when narrow

classes.name: sidebar-right
classes.description: same as sidebar, the sidebar is the last child

classes.name: cover
classes.description: full viewport height; first child at top, last at bottom, middle centred; a single child is centred

classes.name: switcher
classes.description: row that becomes a stack below --threshold (default 30rem)

classes.name: frame
classes.description: fixed aspect ratio box (--ratio, default 16/9); img or video inside covers it

classes.name: reel
classes.description: horizontal scroll strip with snap; give it tabindex="0" and an aria-label so keyboards can scroll it

classes.name: grow
classes.description: child grows to fill remaining space

classes.name: text-left
classes.description: align text to the start (left in LTR)

classes.name: text-right
classes.description: align text to the end (right in LTR)

classes.name: truncate
classes.description: one line, ellipsis when too long

classes.name: bg-primary
classes.description: solid primary background; text, links and focus rings become readable on it

classes.name: bg-primary-soft
classes.description: light primary tint with matching text and link colour

classes.name: bg-success
classes.description: solid success background; text, links and focus rings become readable on it

classes.name: bg-success-soft
classes.description: light success tint with matching text and link colour

classes.name: bg-warning
classes.description: solid warning background; text, links and focus rings become readable on it

classes.name: bg-warning-soft
classes.description: light warning tint with matching text and link colour

classes.name: bg-danger
classes.description: solid danger background; text, links and focus rings become readable on it

classes.name: bg-danger-soft
classes.description: light danger tint with matching text and link colour

classes.name: bg-info
classes.description: solid info background; text, links and focus rings become readable on it

classes.name: bg-info-soft
classes.description: light info tint with matching text and link colour

classes.name: min-width-0
classes.description: allow a flex or grid child to shrink below its content

classes.name: visually-hidden
classes.description: hidden visually, read by screen readers

classes.name: transition

css.transition: color var(--transition), background-color var(--transition), border-color var(--transition), opacity var(--transition), transform var(--transition), translate var(--transition), box-shadow var(--transition)

classes.description: smooth colour, opacity, transform and shadow changes

classes.name: button
classes.description: button look for <a> (a <button> needs no class)

classes.name: card
classes.description: surface panel with border, radius, padding

classes.name: prose
classes.description: long-form text: measure, rhythm, headings, lists

classes.name: icon
classes.description: 1em icon in the current text colour on svg
